official_effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.

required_processing.operation: Reveal/remove A EX13-069#1 from A security; checked card is temporarily in no area
Its Security effect triggers and immediately activates without pending activation; mandatory free play cannot be declined
Play the same physical A EX13-069#1 directly into A battle as an unsuspended Tamer without paying cost; do not create a hand/trash detour
Actual A own-Tamer play triggers the currently available A EX13-022#1 All Turns observer; queue its ordinary derived effect after immediate Security processing, with A as controller
No Security Digimon exists and no DP comparison occurs. Checked card now belongs to A battle, so security cleanup must not move it to trash
Resolve all A ordinary pending effects before the next attack timing/end can advance; no new Counter/Block window or retroactive suspension event

actual_observer.expiry_explanation: The observer belongs to A, so their/opponent turn refers to current B turn6; existing B-owned grants expiring A turn7 remain unchanged.

nontriggers: New EX13-069 has no On Play effect.
Its Start of Your Main Phase timing did not occur now; no memory gain.
Its Your Turn unsuspend/draw/evolve effect is inactive in B turn and no actual unsuspend happened.
A BT11 Rina suspension observer sees no new A Digimon suspension.
B BT11 Rina cannot retroactively see prior attack suspension; playing opponent A Tamer is not suspension.
B Aero own-Tamer observers do not trigger from opponent A Tamer; their current OPT is also already consumed.
A inherited egg is in breeding and A is not active; B egg observes own B blue Tamers and does not trigger from A play.
A Aero shared OnPlay/WhenDigivolving/WhenAttacking Tamer-play effect is separate and does not trigger merely because a Tamer was played.
No DP battle, deletion, unsuspend or repeat check is created by Tamer Security free play.

expected_result_after_security_and_obser.pending_rule: A observer must be resolved before END_ATTACK advances

implementation_constraints: Security effect immediate priority is not an optional ordinary pending activation choice.
Free play is controlled by A even though B is active; ordinary main-action active-player requirement does not apply to this bound Security play.
Do not require own Digimon target or an On Play handler for EX13-069: it has no On Play effect.
Do not let final checked-card cleanup remove the Tamer after it reaches battle.
Do not manufacture ordinary observer effects from earlier attack suspensions or past phase-start events.
